name: Example 1
input: Logger calls at (1, hello), (3, world), (7, hello), (12, hello), and (15, world)
test:
logger = Logger()
assert [
    logger.shouldPrintMessage(1, 'hello'),
    logger.shouldPrintMessage(3, 'world'),
    logger.shouldPrintMessage(7, 'hello'),
    logger.shouldPrintMessage(12, 'hello'),
    logger.shouldPrintMessage(15, 'world'),
] == [True, True, False, True, True]

name: Example 2
input: Logger calls at (5, app), (5, app), (15, app), and (15, blog)
test:
logger = Logger()
assert [
    logger.shouldPrintMessage(5, 'app'),
    logger.shouldPrintMessage(5, 'app'),
    logger.shouldPrintMessage(15, 'app'),
    logger.shouldPrintMessage(15, 'blog'),
] == [True, False, True, True]
